Description: GitHub OIDC delivery for one existing node through a fixed, digest-verified Linux container deployer.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: protected GitHub branch -> short-lived role -> dedicated command -> fixed host deployer
must: Deploy only to the existing node in this stack's Region; create no servers.
Keep application credentials, configuration, account data and statistics outside release packages and code rollback.
The root-owned host deployer pins the repository and deploy-<commit>/release.tar.gz release path.
Host deployer installation and updates are separately managed; release archives cannot overwrite it.
Use a stack name of at most 51 characters so its IAM role name fits the 64-character limit.
Reuse the existing GitHub OIDC provider; never create a duplicate global issuer.

GitHubOwnerName.Description: GitHub repository owner name; must match the host deployer's fixed repository.

GitHubRepositoryName.Description: GitHub repository name; must match the host deployer's fixed repository.

DeploymentBranch.Description: Exact branch allowed to assume the deployment role; no GitHub environment subject is used.

TargetManagedNodeId.Description: Newly verified replacement node in this stack's Region.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Trigger the root-owned fixed-repository Docker deployer without general shell access.
must: Only accept a commit and SHA-256; never caller-supplied paths, commands or URLs.
Verify the current protected branch, archive digest, image revision and health/auth checks.
Keep runtime environment, data and log mounts outside images.

Content.description: Deploy a verified Linux Docker image from the fixed GitHub repository.

ArtifactSha256.description: Exact SHA-256 of the fixed repository's release.tar.gz asset.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: narrowly scoped deployment trigger; excludes general RunShellScript, document mutation and role passing
must: Exact immutable owner/repository IDs and branch subject; never permit a repository wildcard.
SendCommand may target only this document and this one managed node.
No PassRole, Session Manager, IAM mutation, resource provisioning or cross-Region command access.
GetCommandInvocation requires Resource '*'; it can read other command output in this Region.
The original delivery stack retains ownership of the reused account-wide OIDC provider.

Properties.Description: Trigger the fixed code-only deployer on one existing managed node.

RoleArn.Description: Role assumed by the protected GitHub branch through OIDC.

DocumentName.Description: Dedicated SSM command accepting CommitSha and ArtifactSha256 only.

DeploymentRegion.Description: Region containing the existing managed node and deployment document.

TargetManagedNodeId.Description: Sole managed node to which the GitHub role may send the document.
